name: imvia-studio
description: Independent local IMVIA Studio MCP with an optional, default-disabled read-only Lovart capability probe.

interface.shortDescription: Local workbench with an optional read-only probe.
interface.longDescription: IMVIA Studio provides isolated local MCP, JSON state, task lifecycle, managed result import, loopback HTTP/SSE services, and an optional default-disabled read-only Lovart capability probe. It never uploads, generates, confirms costs, or reconfigures Lovart.
defaultPrompt: Check the IMVIA Studio MCP health.
